title: Set up Tugra
createFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
welcomeBody: A few quick steps to get your hub ready. You can skip any of them.
adminBody: The first account on this instance becomes the owner.
setupCodeHint: Shown by the installer in your terminal. Closed it? On your server run: grep SETUP_CODE .env — it proves you set up this box.
name: Name
basicsBody: Name your team and confirm the address. You can change these later in Settings.
publicUrlHint: The address agents and browsers use to reach this hub.
acmeEmailHint: Used for your apps' SSL certificates.
serverBody: Give it a name — you'll get a one-line command to run on the machine.
localServerBody: This machine is being connected automatically — no command to run.
runThisCommand: Run this on your server, then wait here:
waitingForServer: Waiting for the server to connect…
reissueHint: The enroll command expired before the server connected.
workloadBody: Deploy an app from a Git repository, or install one in a click from the app store.
doneBody: Your instance is ready. Manage everything from the dashboard.
modeBody: Pick the experience that fits. You can switch anytime in Settings.
modeFleetDesc: Servers, teams, deploys, clusters and monitoring. Best for managing one or many servers.
modeHomeDesc: A clean app launcher (CasaOS-style) for running self-hosted apps on this box. The fleet tools stay out of the way.
modeSwitchHint: Not sure? Pick Fleet — you can switch to Home anytime in Settings.
basicsMore: The public URL is where servers and browsers reach this hub, for example https://hub.example.com. The Let's Encrypt email receives certificate expiry notices. Both were filled in from your install when we could; check them before you continue.
emailBody: Send invites and password resets from your own address. Optional.
emailLater: You can test it any time in Settings, under Instance.
securityBody: Two-factor authentication protects the owner account. Optional, but recommended.
summaryBody: Everything you entered, in one place. Edit anything before you finish.
summaryOnRequired: On, required for owners and admins
serverNameHint: Leave it blank and the server's own hostname is used. You can rename it later.
